signatures.description: Hilo DF-WARPFS-2: a CLI accepted bare repo-relative paths, sys: and pkg: id forms but rejected a file:-prefixed path with a file-not-found-sounding error. Fix pattern: (1) one pub shared strip_file_prefix helper in the LIBRARY crate (not the CLI) so MCP/FFI callers normalize identically; (2) normalize at the entry of EVERY resolution entry point before the guards, so downstream cache/parse paths see the bare form; (3) keep the pre-existing stable error substring (other suites assert it) and APPEND a hint naming all accepted id forms; (4) a pub const hint string shared by library + CLI bail sites; (5) tests assert prefixed and bare produce EQUAL results and that the prefixed form does not become its own graph node. Foreman verification that beat the worker self-report: rebuild the binary and diff `cli cmd <barepath>` vs `cli cmd file:<barepath>` output — byte-identical diffs are the real proof; concurrent invocations against the same DuckDB-backed store fail with a lock error, so run them sequentially.
